units.source_text: 朱雀院读了这诗，回思往事，历历在目。

en.t: After reading this poem, the Suzaku Retired Emperor thought back on the past, and every memory came vividly before his eyes.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后将此玉梳转赠三公主，意思是祝她不妨肖似自己。

en.t: Empress Akikonomu passed this jade comb on to the Third Princess, meaning it as a wish that the princess might grow to resemble her.
It was a gift of great honor.

units.source_text: 因此朱雀院的答诗中绝不提及昔日为她失恋之情：

en.t: For that reason, in his reply poem the Suzaku Retired Emperor made no mention at all of his old heartbreak over her:
